messages:
Alex C: morning handoff — quick summary of overnight incident and current state. had an embedding autoscaler thrash that caused replica churn and a burst of 5xxs for the /v1/embeddings endpoint. PagerDuty page at ~02:14 UTC.

PagerDutyBot: Pager triggered: PD_INCIDENT_8472 - embeddings-pool-high-error-rate (02:14 UTC) — alerting on >1% 5xx over 5m for embeddings-prod-eu.

Alex C: timeline in short: 02:14 alert -> 02:18 first oncall responded (me) -> 02:20 we saw scale-up loops (new pods failing health) -> 02:27 fallback routing initiated to embed-lite-v2 -> 02:30 autoscaler scaled back to 3 -> 02:45 errors dropped to baseline.

Morgan T: what we did: disabled horizontal autoscaler for embeddings pool, forced stable replica count, pushed routing override to send heavy traffic to embed-lite-v2 for 1h, and increased admission_control token bucket for embeddings from 80 -> 120 rps to absorb burst.

Lee P: added short-term cache warmup for hot prefixes from the last 24h (manual prefetch). also cleared a stuck KV lock on node-gpu-07 which was causing slow health probes.

Alex C: commands run (copied here):
```
# freeze autoscaler and set replicas to 3
kubectl -n inference patch hpa embeddings-autoscaler --type merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3,"maxReplicas":3}}'

# routing override to fallback model
redwoodctl routing override set --pool embeddings-prod-eu --fallback-model embed-lite-v2 --ttl 1h

# admission control tweak
redwoodctl admission update --service embeddings --rate 120
```

OncallBot: Incident note created: INC-2026-8472. Linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler

Morgan T: customer impact: some enterprise customers saw embedding request 5xxs for ~12 minutes (02:16-02:28 UTC). No data loss. Latency p95 for embeddings spiked to ~1.4s from baseline 0.6s. We routed heavy customers to embed-lite-v2; output quality for downstream similarity jobs degraded slightly — CS notified for visible regressions.

Alex C: mitigation status: primary mitigations applied and held. error rate is now <0.2% for the last 10m. p95 latency back to 0.7s. no new pages in last 45m.

Srini R: follow-ups I picked up: 1) root-cause deep-dive (investigate health-check flapping and lock on node-gpu-07), 2) autoscaler behaviour test in staging with injected slow-probe, 3) add a soft-rate-limit config to avoid immediate scale loops. I'll create tickets.

Lee P: runbook gaps noted: health-check backoff not documented well; I'll add a short section under the runbook (link above) and include the exact kubectl patch commands + probe thresholds we used.

Katie S: coverage note — tonight's overnight APAC window (00:00-06:00 PDT) will have limited coverage: only primary/secondary listed below (no dedicated APAC oncall). If a regional failover is needed, we may need to escalate to on-call SRE list.

Alex C: outstanding action items (who/what):
- Srini R: create INC-8472 follow-up ticket with runbook PR link + RCA target 48h.
- Morgan T: monitor embeddings error rate + quality regressions for 6h, roll back routing override after 1h if stable.
- Lee P: update runbook and add health-probe doc.
- Katie S: coordinate with CS if customers report embedding quality regressions overnight.

Alex C: hands-off: I'm handing to Srini R (primary) and Katie S (secondary). Srini — you own the RCA and follow-ups. Katie — coverage + CS liaison. If anything pages, @PagerDutyBot will notify both.

Srini R: acknowledged. I'll check logs for node-gpu-07 probe failures and schedule a control-plane test for autoscaler in staging.

Morgan T: monitoring: grafana alert link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/embeddings/embeddings-prod (watch p50/p95/5xx). I left a dashboard pinned to the oncall board.

Alex C: also note: we left the routing override in place until 03:30 UTC to be safe; it will auto-expire. If you want earlier rollback, run:
```
redwoodctl routing override clear --pool embeddings-prod-eu
```

Lee P: postmortem timeline stub will be started in the incident doc. I'll add the logs we collected and the kubectl diff.

OncallBot: Reminders set: follow-up ticket due 48h, RCA doc due 72h.

Alex C: that's it. quick and stable right now. Srini/Katie — any questions before I sign off?

Katie S: none. thanks Alex.

Srini R: running a quick grep for health-check errors now, will ping if I see a repeat.

Alex C: thanks team. handing off. :wave:
